description:
Read an artifact by its pointer memory id (memory_retrieve on a pointer shows an "artifact" block with head_rev_id and outline).
Bodies over 40,000 characters return the outline: read a section (heading path or JSON pointer) or page=0,1,... Returns rev_id; pass it as base_rev_id when you write.

section.description: Markdown heading path (array) or JSON pointer string.

name: artifact_read
